New raw: `raw/stripe-payments-nz-bank-account-accept-a-payment-2026-11-07.md`. Prior raw: `raw/stripe-nz-becs-accept-payment-2025.md`. Current summaries: `wiki/sources/source-stripe-nz-becs-accept-payment.md`.

- Q1: For `https://docs.stripe.com/payments/nz-bank-account/accept-a-payment`, what central documented behavior, prerequisites, identities and state boundaries does the complete new capture establish, and how does it compare with the matched old capture and every mapped current summary?

- Q2: Which changes are substantive versus presentational or navigation-only? Which historical claims must remain dated, which conflicts need reciprocal warnings, and which API, UI, version, client/server or outcome qualifications prevent unsupported inferences?

reviewed_answers.Q1: At https://docs.stripe.com/payments/nz-bank-account/accept-a-payment, November documents NZD web Elements acceptance through a server-created PaymentIntent, a customer-configured Account using customer_account or a Customers v1 object using customer, Dashboard enablement and dynamic display of eligible methods (new raw lines 13-15 and 31-108). The separate November overview adds NZ eligibility, approval and verification requirements (raw/stripe-payments-nz-bank-account-2026-11-07.md lines 9-27). The guide’s Accounts v2 note describes Connect general availability, public preview for other Stripe users and the preview feature/version steps (new raw lines 35-65). The browser loads Stripe.js directly from js.stripe.com, initializes Stripe with the client publishable key, and uses the Intent's client secret to collect details and accept Direct Debit Authority terms in Payment Element (old raw lines 184-203; new raw lines 161-180 and 195-232). A custom UI must display the terms and confirm acceptance itself, and mandate records must be supplied on request (new raw lines 195-232). For NZ BECS alone, stripe.confirmPayment can use redirect='if_required' and omit return_url. A redirect-based method added to the dynamic integration requires return_url (old raw lines 266-293; new raw lines 241-267). The sample handles errors and requires_payment_method. Successful submission enters processing, and fulfillment waits for independently verified success. Stripe recommends using webhooks, such as payment_intent.succeeded, and also shows the events in Dashboard (new raw lines 275-289). Send mandate confirmation after successful confirmation and give the date and amount of each debit by debit day, with Stripe sending by default (new raw lines 241-289). The guide illustrates reuse of the attached PaymentMethod after the original PaymentIntent succeeds with setup_future_usage=off_session and adds scheduled debit statuses and associated Charge tracking (new raw lines 291-321 and 355-368). The separate overview contradicts the off-session examples.
